prompt: Create a square restrained painterly illustration of Nachtkrapp, the night raven of European bedtime cautionary folklore. The enormous black raven perches outside a village window at night, looking in. Inside the warmly lamplit room a fully clothed parent gently pulls the wooden shutters closed and points toward a bed, illustrating a bedtime warning. No attack or injury. Raven dominates foreground with one head, two folded wings, two feet and ordinary black eyes. Mythic immense scale relative to adult and window makes this a folklore scene.
